optional.note: Higgsfield CLI unlocks 20+ image models, 16 video models, and up to 4K resolution. Without it, the skill falls back to Pollinations.ai (free, no auth, 768x768 max, image only). After installing, run `higgsfield auth login` once per OS user to store the auth token locally. Do not commit the token file.

install_note: Core image generation uses Pollinations.ai (free, no auth). Install the optional Higgsfield CLI for paid premium models and video generation.
